title: Phone tapping, audits and unmarked cars after the leak

tellings.quote: I started to notice that every time I picked up the phone to talk, there was someone on the other end listening

plain: After word leaked out in 1996 that a São Paulo hospital in Brazil had operated on an alien, the surgeon involved found his phone being listened to, faced audits and saw unmarked cars around him, according to the surgeon himself, Carlos de Souza. He says that every time he picked up the phone, there was someone on the other end listening. He tells it as a sign that someone powerful wanted to watch or silence him.
